evidence: Labeled Validation; removes M_ERROR from BlockValidationState and converts ConnectBlock, AcceptBlock, FlushStateToDisk, and ActivateBestChain to return util::Expected<T, kernel::FatalError>.
rationale: Decouples fatal system runtime failures from block validity across core validation routines, eliminating a long-standing architectural hazard where callers had to disentangle invalid blocks from disk or memory failures. The refactor also explicitly enables cleaner return semantics in #35570.
